title: Editorial check fails after save on Machines on Machines: Editorial context tenant mismatch
description: After stories save-version on newsroom.machines-on-machines.anth.us in the signed-in lane, on 2026-11-04, the automatic check printed: not checked, GraphQL request failed: Editorial context tenant mismatch. The copy_edit step depends on this check, so Stories on this site may be unable to complete that step. Not yet tested with editorial check-version directly.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Confirmed 2026-11-04: papyrus editorial check-version --item on the current version fails directly with the same error, Editorial context tenant mismatch. This blocks the copy_edit step for the first Story on Machines on Machines, now at copywriting.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Fixed: the editorial-checks Lambda now receives the tenant (#1170). Tested live on Machines on Machines on 5.85.0: save-version printed 0 violations, 0 for review.
